title: Sea God Forgot His Medusa Bride
intro: Sirenna, shunned for her Medusa-cursed blood, was abandoned by her family as a child. her fiancé abandoned her and she fell into the sea. Her blood freed the sea god Taras from an abyssal curse. One night together, then he vanished to heal. Melidia intercepted his guards, so Sirenna believed he'd left her. She bore twins, lost one, and raised Ariane in hiding. Five years later, her family kidnapped Ariane to force her marry Taras, but he didn't recognize her. In the abyss temple, she found Cassandra, the stolen twin. Melidia trapped her, but Taras uncovered the truth, saved her, and exposed the lie. Sirenna became his wife, and earned his family's respect.
category: Mermaid / Merman, One-night stand, Comeback, Babies, Western Fantasy
title_zh: 海神忘记了他的美杜莎新娘

title: One Night With A Racer, Two Wolf Cubs
intro: After one reckless night with racing star Dean, Katie gives birth to twins who turn out to be wolf cubs. To protect them, she hides the truth alone. But her mischievous daughter Nicole and gentle son Felix are determined to find their father and reunite the family. Dean feels an inexplicable closeness to the cubs, yet jealousy, debt, and lies keep tearing them apart. What Katie doesn't know is that the father is hiding a secret too, he's a werewolf.
category: Werewolf, Competitive, One-night stand, Babies, Pets, Single Mom Escape
title_zh: 与赛车手一夜，得两只狼崽

title: Star Alpha's Fated Is That Omega He Humiliated!
intro: Ian Dawson, star Alpha of the Black Diamonds, humiliates Omega substitute Avi Adler after a lost game. Avi has loved Ian for three years, but on his coming-of-age day, the Blood Moon names him Ian's fated mate, and Ian rejects him publicly. Avi's wolf spirit weakens under a curse. Ian later realizes the scent he was drawn to was Avi's and chases him relentlessly. Ian's uncle and Avi's mother become partners, making them family. Avi transforms, refuses Ian's late confession, until only Ian's mark can save his life. After a brutal foul in a match, they finally confess in the medical room. Ian promises to be an Alpha only for Avi.
category: Campus & Youth, Competitive, BL, ABO Universe, Werewolf
title_zh: 星际首领的命定，是他羞辱过的Omega

title: She Faked An Engagement, He Made It True
intro: Savannah lied that she was engaged to her best friend Roman, a billionaire, rather than watch her sister Chloe marry her ex Dean. Roman played along to protect her. Facing Chloe's schemes, Dean's obsession, and her father's scorn, their feelings buried for five years exploded. Chloe's pregnancy wasn't Dean's, and her wedding was a revenge plot. Roman helped Savannah confront the professor who assaulted her and exposed the family's cover-up. Meanwhile, Roman's own family wound surfaced. Savannah left for the desert, but returned to him. He proposed with his mother's ring. They burned every bridge and left for freedom.
category: Modern Romance, Family Feud, Redemption, Billionaires, Angst to Fluff
title_zh: 她假订婚，他当真

title: The Playboy Married A Genius
intro: Nova Sterling, a genius national scientist, was publicly betrayed by her fiancé and her sister at their engagement party, while her adoptive parents watched coldly. She walked away calmly, but her identity was already exposed. She led the billion-dollar Aegis defense project, and a mole was selling secrets. The general arranged a hidden marriage with playboy CEO Roman as a shield. After the wedding, Nova hid her true brilliance, bickered with Roman, and infiltrated the Sterling and Cross families to execute her revenge with fists and code. When the mole was caught and her identity revealed, Roman had already fallen for her. The war of this genius woman had just begun.
category: Modern Romance, Family Feud, Revenge, Genius, Secret Marriage
title_zh: 花花公子娶了天才

title: Daytime Instructor, Nighttime Stepbrother
intro: Elio is in a gay bar by accident, and a masked man ties him up to flirt with him. Elio flees, but when he enters St. Hurst Police Academy, he finds Damian, the High Commissioner and his new stepbrother, familiar. Is Damian the masked man? Elio must find out, and decide whether he like man.
category: BL, BDSM, Forbidden Love, Power Couple, Campus, Police Officer

Then the homewrecker called again, just to gloat. But Linsey didn't cry. She turned around, walked outside the church, and married the first man she saw. As fate would have it, he turned out to be the most powerful man in the city...

title: The Prince Is A Girl: A Dark Romance Fantasy
intro: Years ago, Emeriel, a human, was sent to the beastman kingdom as a slave. Her blood restored the feral beast king Daemonikai to sanity. She fled that night, and discovered she was pregnant. For five years, she lives as a blood slave in an apothecary workshop in Ash Town with her three children: Vera, who cannot shift, and sons Aldric and Soren. Daemonikai wakes and tracks her scent to Ash Town. After near misses, Barlow's hunt, and a sewer escape, he saves the dying Emeriel. Reunited, they face Marta's schemes and Zaiper's betrayal. Daemonikai kills Marta and finds a cure that doesn't harm Emeriel or the children. The family of five reunites in the palace, and Emeriel becomes queen.
